args.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts
The CSV export helper delegates row formatting to `toDelimited` in `src/exportUtils.ts`, which appears to dedup or merge rows with matching attributes across currencies. We will investigate `src/exportUtils.ts` (or the underlying row collection / serialization logic) to ensure transactions with different currencies are properly preserved in the exported CSV.
